title: The Sun Rises in the East
body:
(AusDerDunkelheitInsLicht, deutsch)
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad. Madad yaa Sultan. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Tabaarak Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Tabarak Allah wa ta'ala Allah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyy,
Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyy,
Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyy,
Hayyy, Hayyy, Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy, Hayyy, Huuuuuuuuu.
As-salaamu `alaykum `alaa ta'if al-jinn. Marhaban bikum, welcome to you, attenders of jinns. They are
interested in hearing something every night and their kings are attending. Tonight there are seven mulook al-

jinn, kingdoms of jinn (a).
As-salaamu `alaykum, attenders from Ummati Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Zidhu Habeebika
Yaa Rabbee,`izzan wa sharafan wa nooran wa surooran yaa Allah. (Give more to Your Beloved of dignity and
honor and light and joy, O Allah). (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) We are never happy when we are saying "we."
Dastoor, yaa RijaalAllah. (That is) believers are never happy when the Seal of Prophets (s) is not respected
on Earth; we are very sorry from that and all Muslims must be sorry for that purpose. Allah Almighty is
giving highest honor to His most beloved and honored servant on this Earth, and (for him) not to be
respected, not to be honored, makes the seven heavens to be like a yatak (bed), coming like this. And anger
from angels that the most respected one (is not) respected on Earth, that is such a bad happening! That is the
reason cursing comes on people, because they are not giving their most high respect, most high love, and
most high taqdeer (appreciation) for the Seal of Prophets (s), who is the most beloved one in the Divinely
Presence! Laa hawla wa laa quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem. May Allah forgives us and send us
someone to put everything on its real position! Huuuuuu.
We are saying, as-salaamu `alaykum, yaa representative of heavens on this world, Qutb al-Mutassarif! We
are saying to you also, as-salaamu `alaykum. One man granted to look for every happening on this planet,
and you are so powerful. We are giving our respect to you because you are representative of heavens on
Earth, then we are asking forgiveness from the Lord of Heavens.
O People! We must begin by saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Always say this at least say
seven times daily, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. If you are asking for more, you may say forty
times, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. If you are asking to reach the level of accepted servants
and saved from the dirtiness of Shaytan, they are saying to tell you seventy times, a`oodhu billahi min ashShaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah. Allah.
O our Grandshaykh! That is an entrance, li kulli shay'in baab, from hadith sharif. Salafi `ulamas, are you
hearing? I think you are not understanding, hadith shareef: ••• •• ••• li kulli shayyin baab, "There is a door
opening to everything." If there is no baab (door), you can't enter in it, yes. Therefore, we are saying, a`oodhu
billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem for what? To close down Shaytan's attack through that door. Shaytan is a
terrible creature and you may imagine that if Shaytan can find a way to enter to Paradise, what about here? Is

it not correct, Salafi `ulamas? Don't say, "We are reaching to a safety from Shaytan's tricks and traps." No,
beware of Shaytan! He found a way to enter Paradise, how is that? That means talabana wajadana, "Who is
asking is going to find." If a good or bad person is asking to reach something from goodness, asking to reach
Allah Almighty's pleasure, it is a clear and enlightened way; just open and you may enter it. If a person is
asking another way that makes happy people, dirty ways, for what asking? Because our egos are dirty and its
production is dirtiness. Therefore, it is going to be easy for Shaytan to carry our egos to dirtiness and dirty
ways in darkness. Allahu akbar wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
As an example, common people living on this Earth are asking to enter darkness, yes. What does it mean?
Are you understanding such a thing, Salafi `ulamas? You never remembering what we are saying! (laughter)
Look. Darkness is the last, final target for Mankind. When they are following their egos, egos are asking to be
in darkness, because darkness covering their beings and no one is looking and seeing you or that one, for
example, but it is reality Man running to darkness! Are you understanding what we are saying, O Salafi
`ulamas? Qul haatoo burhaanakum, "Say, 'Bring your proofs.'" You may say, "Bring your proof," and I may
say what is coming to me. Subhaan Allah, perhaps no one is thinking on that point!
You know New Year, passing from 2009 to 2010; what they are running to that night, when the clocks are
saying, dong, dong, dong...12 o'clock, Shaytan orders turn down all lights to leave people in darkness where
they will be so happy! Coming to your mind such things? I don't know. That is proof, and they are saying if
that darkness may continue, "It is only for one minute, so what is that? We are not satisfied with one minute,
so leave that darkness up to morning. We are so happy to be in that darkness!" That is a big proof that our
egos are asking to be in darkness, and every time egos carry people to darkness. Therefore, they are running
away from enlightened worlds and Enlightened Oceans. They are asking to enter in darkness areas and their
egos are saying, and Shaytan is calling them, "Come! Come to me! Come to your darkness territories (that
are) waiting for you! Come and you will find everything here as a dream. Come to darkness!" Shaytan is
calling people to darkness; that is proof and no one can say "no," not even the pope, the chief rabbi, and
Dala`i Lama can't say! Their egos are asking to be in darkness on that night, to be happy in darkness, not to
be seen what they are doing. They are saying, "The top of pleasure is in darkness!"
People living on this Earth are not coming to enlightened people; they are escaping, running away from
enlightenment. Therefore, in daytime they are working like donkeys and waiting for darkness coming at

night. "We must reach night, such a nice area for completing our egoistic desires. Oh nighttime, in black
areas, where no one sees what we are doing! Ohhhh we like it, we never like lights."
All religions bring heavenly lights from heavens. Whom they are? Messengers of the Lord of Heavens coming
and why, O Salafi `ulamas, what is your opinion? Why nations, nation of Noah (a), Moses (a), Abraham (a),
Yunus (a), Jesus Christ (a), Zakariyyah (a), and last one, the tribe of the Seal of Prophets (s) why are they
quarrelling and fighting with the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)? (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) He
is bringing heavenly lights and they are saying ptuu (spit)! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
•••••••••• ••• ••••••••••• ••••• ••••••
yureedoona an yutfioo noor Allah. They want to extinguish God's (guiding) light with their utterances. (9:32)
O Salafi `ulamas! Are you understanding what means, yureedoona an yutfioo noor Allah? Followers of
Shaytan wish to extinguish the Light of Allah! And Shaytan is cheating them and saying, "Don't go to that
one, because he is bringing lights and in lights you can't enjoy yourself. You must be in darkness; in darkness
you can do everything because no one prevents you as no one is seeing what you are doing. Therefore, don't
run after that one because just he is bringing lights, and if his lights open you can't do anything for your
egoistic pleasures, because your egos asking to be in darkness, to do everything there and not to be seen."
Salafi `ulamas, say, don’t worry! Why are you not reminding people, "O People! Western countries are in
darkness and like to bring their darkness to oriental countries on Muslims. They are asking to bring their
darkness to Enlightened Territories on enlightened Muslim people."
Therefore, the representatives of Shaytan in the Islamic world are trying to bring darkness from western
countries to oriental countries, to where the sun is shining, as in the west the sun is setting. Use your
mentality! Why are you following the darkness of western countries? All of them like darkness. All day they
are working for reaching the night's pleasure for their egoistic demands, and they are asking to reach that
pleasure in darkness. Therefore, they are never interested in real beliefs or real lights coming from heavens.
O Salafi `ulamas! Why are you not saying, "O our kings, our doctors, our learned people! Why are you
running to the west? What are you finding, where the sun sets in western territories?” Why are you not
reminding your people, "O Believers! Why are you sending your people to western countries?" Is it not
enough what the Seal of Prophets (s) brought to you? Why are you not saying? You are only occupying

yourself with saying, "That is bidaa`, that is kufr, that is shirk, that is haraam." The biggest haraam is not to
say to people, "Don't look to western countries, look to where the sun is rising. You will see everything clearly
when the sun is shining. There is one sun for the whole world. It has a material rising and setting, but for
humanity the real sun is now rising from the east, from sun-shining area; the real sun is the Seal of Prophets,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Come to him! If you are asking for real humanity,
come and follow! Come from west to east! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
O People! Uhadhirukum, I am warning you, I am warning whole Muslim world! If they are going to west
where the sun is setting, going to be there in darkness. Who is going there, it never leaves any lights in the
hearts of Muslims, and their hearts are going to be in darkness. When they go there, their lights will finish in
western countries. If people of western countries coming to oriental countries, their feelings change and they
begin to understand reality.
O People! Don't think that technology is a reality and you are going so proud from your technology. What is
technology, (other than) making people to be in more darkness! Technology is making people to lose their
real beings and forget what heavenly grants just granted to them. What is that? Say it, don't fear!
O Salafi `ulamas! You are always fighting with me; don't fight with me! My words are one-hundred percent
reality and comply with what Holy Qur'an is saying; our words are on it. We are asking for people (to be
granted) enlightened worlds and lightening in their lives here and Hereafter. Who are running after
technology, their lives will be in darkness here and Hereafter.
O People! O People! I am fighting with my ego, everyone should respect yourselves. If I am saying something
wrong, Allah Almighty is able to punish me or forgive me; He knows. But we have been granted a reminder in
Holy Qur'an, saying, “Say to people, to remind them where it is enlightened territories and where darkness
and dark oceans." That is the Seal of Prophets (s) coming to take people out from darkness to enlightened
areas. But Shaytan and our egos are saying, "No, we are happy and in pleasure with darkness.”
Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah.
That is an important warning for all nations. May Allah (swt) forgive me and forgive you. We must
understand from Holy Qur'an. I am a weak servant. I can't enter the oceans of Holy Qur’an, but in beaches

they are granting to me to remind people about their real beings, about their senses, and to teach them what
way is going to be best for them, to protect them here and Hereafter. Only they are granting us a heavenly
grant to be much more lights to our hearts, but people are running away from lights. As we said now, a
handful of people are asking for lights but a majority of people are running to darkness oceans and they will
be in darkness oceans to Eternity, very terrible end.
O People! From east to west, including my ego, and pope's ego, and bishop's ego, rabbi's egos, leave them and
come to and enlightened world, that its lights just reached to all nations with the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
(Mawlana Shaykh sings in Turkish)
Yaa Muhammad, canim arzular seni.
Dost Muhammad, canim pek sever seni.
Padischah konmaz saraya hane mamur olmadan.
kenz açilmaz schol gönülden ta ki pür nur olmyinca.
Yaa Muhammad, my soul is yearning for you.
Yaa Muhammad, you are my true love.
A king is not put in a palace before it is adorned.
A heart's treasure is unlocked only when that heart is purified.
Hayyy, hayyy, hayyy.
O our Lord don’t leave us in darkness. You granted Your weak servants faith and real beliefs. All prophets are
asking to take out people from darkness oceans to enlightened oceans; that is it, nothing else, the summary of
meanings of holy books. What is just clear, anything spoken by Adam (a), or Noah (a), or Abraham (a), or
Moses (a), or Sulayman (a), or David (a), or John (a), or `Isa (a), Zachariah (a), or Yahya (a). And all
prophets were coming to take people from darkness to enlightened heavenly oceans.
May Allah (swt) forgive us for the honor of the most honored one, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits.)

Fatihah.
(42 minutes)
We knowing (and they are) closing, enough, enough. Allah Allah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Hajjah Naziha on the phone.)
